zoe: kicking off a slow canary for v3.4.0 in EU-west. initial cohort 7%. change window 02:00-03:30 UTC. dashboard https://dash.redwood/internal/rollouts/1890000000
deploy-bot: rollout initiated: v3.4.0 -> 7% (eu-west). cohort=c-zt7
status-bot: scheduled heatchecks at t+3m, t+12m.
ops-sre: watching; will post first snapshot in ~3m.
deploy-bot: t+3m metrics: p50=95ms p95=205ms 5xx=0.15% kv_miss=0.8%
mike: quick FYI saw a small tail on edge-eu5 at t+8m hitting rdx-small-quant variant; tagging ops-sre.
elena: pulling logs now, posting snippet.
elena: ```
[2026-03-24T02:08:14Z] host=eu5-09 model=rdx-small-quant latency=472ms kv_evictions=11 errors=0.6%
[2026-03-24T02:08:15Z] host=eu5-11 model=rdx-small-quant latency=505ms kv_evictions=17 errors=1.0%
```
ops-sre: pattern looks like increased kv-cache churn + occasional GC on quantized path; release notes call out tokenizer + kv-cache adjustments: https://git.redwood/release-notes/v3.4.0
zoe: request hold at 7% while we triage.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 7% (manual by zoe). action=paused_by_zoe id=a-4802
release-manager: recommend regional pin to previous stable variant v3.3.9-quant-euw for the cohort while we investigate. it'll keep the rest of the clusters free to continue rollout if safe.
mike: agree with pin-first approach. queue standby rollback if pin doesn't help after 10m: `/deploy rollback --service=inference --from=v3.4.0 --to=v3.3.9 --region=eu-west --reason="canary_tail_latency"`
deploy-bot: routing override available. change >10% outside quiet window requires lock. current change falls inside window (02:00-03:30 UTC) - allowed.
ops-sre: applying routing override: cohort c-zt7 -> v3.3.9-quant-euw. override id=r-9002
deploy-bot: routing override applied r-9002. cohort pinned.
status-bot: heatcheck t+6m after override: p95=178ms 5xx=0.28% kv_eviction_rate down.
zoe: good signal. propose hold 12 more minutes then resume slow ramp to 20% with heatchecks every 5m; gates: p95<240ms and 5xx<0.6%.
elena: will keep tail logs and memory counters; raising if anything shifts.
release-manager: will add a note to release notes if we keep the pin or execute rollback: https://git.redwood/release-notes/v3.4.0#incidents
mike: standing by to execute queued rollback if we don't see recovery by t+10m.
ops-sre: observing stable metrics for now; no rollback needed.
zoe: thanks all  leaving ops-sre on watch. will post update if we pick up any new anomalies. end.
